title: Japanese Green Vegetable Protection
reason: Describes agricultural practices used in Japan and China.

tasks.task: Explain the Japanese method of protecting green vegetables.

subtasks.text: Observe the use of ultra-durable wire mesh to enclose green vegetables in Japan.

tasks.task: Describe the Chinese practice of using a black mat during tree planting.

subtasks.text: Note the placement of the black mat under tree roots in China.
Observe how the black mat helps to lock in soil moisture and block weeds.
